journeys.name: Command Center to source
journeys.task_statement: Find the one thing in Command Center that needs a signed-in partner's attention, understand why it matters, and get to its original source.
journeys.friction_notes: Run ended on the Notification Center inbox, one click short of the owning source record; the source deep link was not followed. Earlier in the session Joe first attempted the journey against a stale browser window from a previous session (voided, not scored) and separately explored Tour Mode off-path. Product signal: the Home needs-you cards and the notification bell compete for the what-needs-me job; the journey's reach-the-source step was not discovered unaided. Timing not instrumented this run.

journeys.name: Park and restore Myrick
journeys.task_statement: Find the Myrick work record, park it with a reason, prove its history survived, then bring it back.
journeys.friction_notes: Park half run fully unaided: Joe located the exact record, prepared a parking reason, confirmed, and reached the preserved-history and read-back verification without help. Joe then reported the journey done while the artifact still read Parked, version 8, restore unconfirmed, all five pressure fields Excluded. Cause per Joe verbatim: 'i didn't realize your entire question. so i didn't click restore bc i didn't notice your instruction included that step. I defintely saw the button and it was self explanatory.' This is a PROCTOR INSTRUMENT ERROR, not a product defect — the four-clause task statement was issued as a single sentence and the fourth clause did not land; the restore control itself was discovered unaided and read correctly. Restore was then completed after the fourth clause alone was re-stated (no route disclosure; control already located unaided), so restore-dependent criteria are valid evidence with that provenance. ARTIFACT VERIFIED POST-RESTORE: status Active Work, version 8 to 9, prior park event retained plus new 'Restored to Active Work in prototype - attributed to Joe' entry, all five read-back fields flipped Excluded to Included, no history rewrite and no loss. Criteria met: attributed events, read-back, no data loss, version visible. UNTESTED and the reason this is scored partial rather than pass: the conflict half of criterion 1 was never exercised — this journey's flow creates no version conflict, and the conflict state is reachable only through the Preview state selector, which was not used. CROSS-CUTTING EVIDENCE-VALIDITY FINDING, verified in source at workspace/public/js/app.js lines 92-108: journeySteps() renders unconditionally on both Command Center and Deal Room, displaying the expected route as numbered chips with current-step tracking, behind no toggle and no preview-state gate. Workspace journeys therefore cannot be described as purely uncoached, and this applies retroactively to FLOW-WS-01 as scored. Counter-signal limiting the severity: the chips read '5. Restore' and the step was still missed, so the displayed route does not reliably transfer. Timing not instrumented this run; journey carries no speed criterion.

journeys.name: Weekly Deal Room call
journeys.task_statement: Run this week's Deal Room call from start to finish, then review what it produced and handle retention correctly.
journeys.friction_notes: Run unaided and completed end to end. RUN AUTHENTICITY VERIFIED AGAINST THE SHIPPED FIXTURE rather than taken from the partner's report: fixtures/call-review.v1.json ships capture_stage 'ready' with all_candidates_dispositioned, aggregate_summary_confirmed, legal_hold, policy_resolved, recovery_window_elapsed and purge_eligible all false. Observed end state was capture_stage 'complete' with dispositioned and aggregate-confirmed true, which app.js sets only inside the complete-call action (lines 386-389), whose control is disabled while any candidate remains pending (line 135). Joe therefore drove ready to recording to review, dispositioned every candidate individually (all read 'confirmed', none skipped), then confirmed the aggregate summary to reach complete. ALL FIVE CRITERIA MET: (1) parked records excluded — 'Parked records excluded: Paused prospect demo' rendered explicitly alongside the two active records, and the pre-check confirmed this list is fixture-sourced and independent of the Myrick record's state, so journey 2's restore did not contaminate it; (2) no guessed speaker or target — every candidate in all seven sections carries 'Exact target: wrk-demo-001 - confirmed', with Joe actions and Dell actions separated and participants named; (3) draft-only outside communication — 'Prepare a check-in draft for review; sending is unavailable' plus the boundary note 'Outside communication remains a draft. Sending is structurally absent. There is no transcript library'; (4) all candidates dispositioned — reported Yes AND mechanically enforced by the disabled finish control, not merely displayed; (5) purge gate truthful — reported Blocked with the reason naming exactly the unmet conditions while correctly reporting legal hold explicitly false as Yes, and purge_eligible is computed as the conjunction of all five flags at line 391, so the gate cannot display Eligible unless every condition actually holds. Criteria 4 and 5 are enforced structurally rather than cosmetically, which is stronger evidence than a visual check. MINOR FRICTION, not a criterion: the 'Work initiated by Doc, Claude, or Codex' section rendered as a heading with no content and no empty-state message. Cross-cutting coaching affordance applies here as it does to all Workspace journeys — journeySteps() rendered the four-step route (Consent gate, Recording, Independent structured review, Retention eligibility) unconditionally. Timing not instrumented; journey carries no speed criterion.

journeys.name: Doc context and engineering request
journeys.task_statement: Ask Doc a grounded question about what you're looking at, then report a problem or improvement and see it through to a submitted request.

journeys.name: Multi-stop Tour Mode
journeys.task_statement: Plan a multi-stop tour around your locked appointment, take it offline, capture a note and a photo along the way, and review what it proposes when you finish.

journeys.name: Whole-market visual planning to governed day trip
journeys.task_statement: Using the whole-market map, put together a day trip of at least two eligible stops around your locked appointment and hand it off for governed Tour approval.
pass_criteria: prospects, active clients, projects in process, active projects, and visits/appointments remain distinguishable
map/list/keyboard parity and non-color meaning are exact
unlocated records remain counted and listed
stale, Unknown, approximate, target-area, and unauthorized stops are excluded with reasons without blocking other eligible stops
whole-market surface is absent in sterile/client-facing mode
no map interaction or route proposal writes canonical truth
routine completed without Claude Code or Codex

journeys.name: Collector failure is honest
journeys.task_statement: Find out whether Production is actually healthy right now, including what happens when a health check itself fails, and see what to do about it.
pass_criteria: last verified time and source are visible

journeys.name: Service and environment provenance
journeys.task_statement: Pick a service and work out what's really running in each environment, Production, Rehearsal, and the planned Staging, plus what else depends on it.
pass_criteria: planned Staging is planned and Unknown
version, schema, configuration, source, and freshness are visible

journeys.name: Business problem to safe Work Request

pass_criteria: origin is linked without client payload

journeys.name: Scoped plan and invalidated approval
journeys.task_statement: Determine exactly what an agent session is scoped and approved to do right now, and confirm that an outdated approval no longer applies.
pass_criteria: current plan has a new hash

journeys.task_statement: Investigate an active incident, separate what's confirmed from what's still a guess, and trace the full record of how it was handled.
